name: pi-dev-starter-kit
description: Pi.dev harness foundation — security, quality, workflow, and tools for any project

scripts.test: npm run test:permission-gate && npm run test:loop-protection && npm run test:rtk-rewrite && npm run test:contrib-gate && npm run test:shared-errors && npm run test:shared-path-utils && npm run test:shared-settings && npm run test:artifact-read && npm run test:lsp-bridge && npm run test:integration
scripts.test:loop-protection: tsc extensions/loop-protection/index.ts tests/loop-protection.test.ts --outDir /private/tmp/pi-dev-starter-kit-tests --module NodeNext --target ESNext --moduleResolution NodeNext --skipLibCheck && node --test /private/tmp/pi-dev-starter-kit-tests/tests/loop-protection.test.js
scripts.test:permission-gate: tsc extensions/permission-gate/index.ts tests/permission-gate.test.ts --outDir /private/tmp/pi-dev-starter-kit-tests --module NodeNext --target ESNext --moduleResolution NodeNext --skipLibCheck && NODE_PATH=$(pwd)/node_modules node --test /private/tmp/pi-dev-starter-kit-tests/tests/permission-gate.test.js
scripts.test:rtk-rewrite: tsc extensions/rtk-rewrite/index.ts tests/rtk-rewrite.test.ts --outDir /private/tmp/pi-dev-starter-kit-tests --module NodeNext --target ESNext --moduleResolution NodeNext --skipLibCheck && NODE_PATH=$(pwd)/node_modules node --test /private/tmp/pi-dev-starter-kit-tests/tests/rtk-rewrite.test.js
